positioning: Google Maps for Cultural Heritage + Wikipedia for Living Culture + AI Cultural Guide + Visual Heritage Recognition + Cultural Voice Archive + Community Preservation Network

theme_support.light_mode_personality: Warm handcrafted parchment, temple stone ivory, terracotta & royal lapis accents
theme_support.dark_mode_personality: Deep midnight basalt, obsidian sanctuary, molten gold, saffron sparks, illuminated manuscript aura

hierarchy_scale.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-tight
hierarchy_scale.caption_overline: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.22em] font-mono text-amber-500 font-semibold

anti_patterns: NEVER use plain Inter or Roboto for H1, H2, or Hero headers
NEVER exceed text-6xl for hero headings on standard breakpoints
Maintain max 2 Tailwind size jump between heading and immediate subtitle

brand_palette_rules: FORBIDDEN: Generic neon purple AI gradients (#7351B7).
Primary CTA: Royal Saffron (#F56A1E / hsl(28 92% 54%)) or Vedic Warm Gold (#E89B17 / hsl(43 92% 54%)).
Background anchors: Basalt Night (#0D1117 / #0B0E14) in dark mode, Sandstone Parchment (#FAF7F2) in light mode.
Accent highlights: Terracotta (#C85A32), Royal Indigo (#3B5998 / #2B3A67), Patina Emerald (#1B7A56).
Glow & Tracing effects: 1px gold/amber illuminated strokes with subtle blur-sm ambient glow.

spacing_and_layout.spacing_scale: Tailwind standard with generous breathing room (p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12, p-16, p-24, p-32).
spacing_and_layout.bento_grid_rules: Use Mode A Tetris Grid for Category Explorer and Preservation sections. Mix col-span-8, col-span-4, col-span-2 with row spans. Never make boring equal boxes.
spacing_and_layout.border_padding_mandate: Every card with border must have internal padding (p-5 to p-8) to prevent text collision.
spacing_and_layout.image_constraints: Mobile height max max-h-[70vh] with rounded-2xl border border-white/10

navigation_and_header.style: Glassmorphism with Optical Clarity (backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/80 border-b border-border/60 sticky top-0 z-50)
elements: Brand Emblem (Geometric Ashoka/Mandala vector) + 'VIRANA' logotype with 'विराना' subtle superscript
Primary Nav: Explore Map, Living Culture, Ask AI, HeritageLens, Preservation, Cultural Calendar
Action Group: Multilingual Switcher (EN / हिं / తె), Dark/Light Toggle, 'Share Heritage' CTA button
navigation_and_header.mobile_rule: Desktop shows full links. Mobile collapses into side drawer with sliding animation.

emotional_preservation_vault.narrative: Every decade, dozens of indigenous dialects vanish, ancient weave patterns are forgotten, and centuries of oral medicinal wisdom disappear with their elders. Virana lets communities digitize and immortalize their living culture before it's gone.

accessibility_and_testing.test_id_mandate: All buttons, inputs, filter chips, dropdowns, and cards MUST include role-based data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='explore-map-button', data-testid='search-input', data-testid='category-card-monuments')

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Read this entire /app/design_guidelines.json file before implementing UI components.
2. Build rich, high-fidelity components with real cultural depth and rich textual storytelling. Avoid placeholder 'Lorem Ipsum' or shallow generic mockups.
3. Use the provided Unsplash image URLs directly in the hero carousel, category cards, and detail modal/pages.
4. Ensure both Dark mode (default deep basalt/gold) and Light mode (sandstone parchment) render flawlessly.
5. Use Lucide icons (Landmark, Sparkles, Music, MapPin, Compass, Search, Calendar, Shield, Camera, Heart, Share2, Volume2, Globe).
6. Include multilingual strings for key headers so switching EN/HI/TE instantly translates the UI.

7. Implement interactive features: Leaflet Map with filtered markers, AI Chat simulation with rich formatted responses and voice narration audio synthesizer (SpeechSynthesis API), HeritageLens camera/upload drag-drop analyzer with realistic match results, and Community Contribution modal.
8. Maintain data-testid on every interactive element.
